headline: Bold 'supply' through expanded PF and eased regulations… careful screening of speculative non-resident owners
summary: Authorities are considering expanded public guarantees, eased prudential regulations and screening of speculative non-resident single-home owners. The steps come amid worsening public sentiment on housing.
why: Housing policy in South Korea affects mortgage lending, construction activity and household wealth, which feed into the broader domestic economy. Changes to lending rules directly influence bank exposure to property.
